findings.title: New Full Catalog Capacity job drops the public catalog fixture setup its predecessor required
findings.body:
Reviewer: claude model=claude-opus-5 thinking=high

`.github/workflows/pr.yaml` splits the old `verification` job into `verification-checks`, `verification-tests`, and `verification-capacity`. The old job declared `STARMAP_PUBLIC_FIXTURE_REQUIRED: '1'` and ran `python3 scripts/prepare_public_catalog_fixture.py` before executing any Go tests, including `TestPublicPublicationProfileRetainsBoundedState` (which lived in `./...`).

The new `verification-capacity` job runs only that test:

```yaml
- name: Run full public catalog capacity
  run: python3 scripts/verification_tests.py capacity --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-capacity-events.jsonl"
```

but it has no `env:` block and no fixture-preparation step. `verification-tests` still prepares the fixture and sets both `*_FIXTURE_REQUIRED` variables, so the asymmetry is confined to the capacity job — the one job whose stated contract (docs/TESTING.md: "`TestPublicPublicationProfileRetainsBoundedState` with the complete corpus") depends on the full public corpus.

If the test gates on the prepared fixture, the unset `STARMAP_PUBLIC_FIXTURE_REQUIRED` makes it skip rather than fail. `scripts/verification_tests.py::summarize` then raises `ValueError("the full-catalog capacity test did not pass")` because `capacity_passed` only becomes true on an `Action == "pass"` record for that exact test/package, so the job exits non-zero. `verification` (`Verification Gate`, the required check) runs with `if: always()` and asserts `CAPACITY == success`, so every pull request would be blocked with no per-PR workaround.

Smallest fix: add `STARMAP_PUBLIC_FIXTURE_REQUIRED: '1'` and the `Prepare verified public catalog fixture` step to `verification-capacity`, mirroring `verification-tests`.

I could not execute the test from the bundle, so this is conditional on `TestPublicPublicationProfileRetainsBoundedState` actually consuming the prepared fixture; if it builds its corpus purely in-process the job is fine as written.

overall_explanation: Panel review complete. claude model=claude-opus-5 thinking=high: 1 finding(s), codex model=gpt-5.6-sol thinking=high: 0 finding(s).
